decisive_spans.text: PET-CT scan demonstrated FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic lymph nodes

response.rationale: D6 is supported by the presence of FDG-avid lymph nodes, which is a key feature of lymphomatoid granulomatosis. D10 is contradicted by the immunophenotype of the atypical lymphocytes.
